justifications.evidence: the five logs carry every done_when check and all end EXIT=, and I re-derived 0 added failures from the two arms' own logs and reproduced the named id green at the committed head (logs/target-test-head.log), but logs/base-suite.log:4 names the wrong tree as the module under test (FINDING below).
justifications.fit: the declaration matches the file's own enum-field idiom — reckon/_schema.py:1099 and 1100 give status and roi the same Field(default, json_schema_extra=_enum(...)) shape — and IMPL_SOURCE_ENUM carries no version, ticket or plan identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: canonical_dump now carries impl_source for the full fixture — the base reproduction at logs/base-gate.log is exactly the missing {'impl_source': 'authored'} item — and I regenerated docs/_shared/plan.schema.json from the reviewed model at the reviewed head and diffed it byte-identical to the committed copy.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit touches only reckon/_schema.py and docs/_shared/plan.schema.json of the four declared paths, and the two untouched paths are the fragment and figure the dispatch bars when the done-when names no artifact.
